title:
Client Interface for Model Registry.
Registering and loading {@link MlPipe} and {@link MlModel} may need additional methods to be implemented.
See {@link MlPipe#replaceEntityReferences}, {@link MlPipe#beforeCreate}.
See {@link MlModel#replaceEntityReferences}, {@link MlModel#beforeCreate}.
See {@link MlInterpreter#backgroundDataByName},
See {@link MlInterpreter#backgroundDataFromMap}.

Users interact with Model Registry using either a URI or a PATH.
1. PATH - Paths can contain multiple components which enables organizing models that are either similar in architecture
or domain into the same group. A path can be constructed in three ways - relative, absolute, and globally unique.
2. URI - Uniquely identifies a model in Model Registry. URI is a concatenation of a globally unique path and version.

The following describes the three ways to construct a path:
1. Relative paths
Relative paths are the quickest way to organize the models - the requirements are that the path must
contain at least one component and that it must not start with a leading slash `/` or 'ModelRegistry-'.
The following are all valid relative paths:
- `My_Classifier`
- `classifiers/Random_Forest`

2. Absolute paths
Absolute paths must start with a leading slash `/` - the only requirement is that the path must contain at least
two components. The default way to convert a relative path to absolute path is to add {@link App} ID as a prefix.
Based on the relative path examples above, the following are all valid absolute paths:
- `/cluster-env-app/My_Classifier`
- `/acme-prod-crm/classifiers/Random_Forest`
In addition, the user can craft their own absolute namespacing for absolute paths:
- `/hello_world_project/My_Classifier`
- `/all_models/classifiers/Random_Forest`

3. Globally unique paths
Globally unique paths start with a `ModelRegistry-ModelRegistry.serviceAppId()`.
The default way to convert a relative/absolute path to a globally unique path is to add the prefix mentioned above.
Users can either craft their globally unique path or use a relative/absolute path which gets internally converted to globally unique path.
Based on the relative and absolute path examples above, the following are all valid globally unique paths:
- `ModelRegistry-cluster-df-ms/cluster-env-app/My_Classifier`
- `ModelRegistry-acme-prod-ms/all_models/classifiers/Random_Forest`

Users can load/list models organized by any path or URI.
However, registering is disallowed using a globally unique path that is not in scope of this client.
See {@link ModelRegistryIface#registerMlPipe} or {@link ModelRegistryIface#registerMlModel} for more details.
